operator_directed_trajectory.current_full_release_goal: Finish the entire Autonomous Agentic Flow State workset and all unfinished previously authorized release obligations, then publish, install and verify the complete canonical signed stable release.
operator_directed_trajectory.immediate_focus: Qualify the canonical priority_issue_numbers batch and all retained release obligations; continue each ready authorized source action without routine check-ins, preserving exact issue acceptance and existing authority boundaries.
operator_directed_trajectory.carryover_policy: Preserve all unfinished prior approved obligations, acceptance, history and evidence with their existing owners; no silent dropping, paper completion, unapproved deferral or scope expansion.
operator_directed_trajectory.remaining_repository_work: After release or workset settlement, assess the remaining issue/task queue and advance the next ready authorized work toward truthful zero without a routine continue prompt; current release completion is not repository completion and real authority, consent and budget limits still apply.

scope_amendments.instruction: Add newly reported repository issues to the existing workset and qualify at least10–15 fixes before the next release.

pre_release_priority_source_qualificatio.acceptance_order: Source/candidate proof precedes release; issue-specific native/installed checks and closure follow delivery where required. Open installed acceptance never becomes a circular prerequisite to build the fixed candidate.
pre_release_priority_source_qualificatio.release_authority: This source amendment grants no release/install, paid CI, worker, credential or external customer action.

work_items.title: Compile the autonomous agentic Flow State release contract and task graph
work_items.done: Source authoring profile, full requirements/issue traceability, dependency graph, task records and contract tests agree; no runtime admission or installed support is fabricated.

work_items.title: Prove replay-safe runtime recovery and storage readiness
work_items.done: Candidate replay preserves event identities, ownership, sequences and durable state; resource/quota pressure is reported truthfully before failed writes; restore/backup evidence survives; supported recovery has an exact bounded next action.

work_items.title: Repair scope, lifecycle and retained approval continuity
work_items.done: Valid project/workstream/frontier inputs admit the requested operation; genuine migration has a supported typed repair; persisted pre-approval is automatically revalidated, not erased or expanded after recovery; foreign/revoked/expired grants remain denied.

work_items.title: Preserve complete instructions and restore the actual accepted goal
work_items.done: Full source-turn instruction and restrictions survive storage, compaction and restart; previews never become authority; accepted HLT restoration uses actual history and retains lineage; fresh operator corrections win without generic-goal substitution.

work_items.title: Attach the work loop to a real executor and stop idle budget drain
work_items.done: Enabled execution proves a current attached writer/transport and advances eligible work; missing transport is not running autonomy; execution/wait/resource accounting follows Spec137, has explicit bounds and never silently renews an exhausted budget.

work_items.title: Deliver and observe real Silent Session work
work_items.done: Exact session/run/generation receives start and steering through the protected runner; real output and terminal receipts prove execution; queued/202 is not started; duplicate delivery, restart, cancellation and stale-generation cases remain safe.

work_items.title: Connect scoped credential requirements, grants and protected use
work_items.done: Actual broker enforcement resolves approved credential references for exact operation/consumer/target/generation, distinguishes use from reveal and verifies provenance, expiry, revocation and challenge support; advisory grant verification alone never authorizes use.

work_items.title: Remove hardcoded vault access and prove value-free secret injection
work_items.done: The approved vault route supplies exact fields to bound consumers without model/log/argv leakage or hardcoded login material; existing renewable access is reused; retries reconcile effects; fixture secret canaries prove redaction without retrieving real values into evidence.

work_items.title: Make renewable MFA and restored connector readiness truthful
work_items.done: A restored encrypted connector proves functional challenge delivery and injection, not route/title readiness; grants are provider/target/consumer/window bound, values remain outside model context, duplicates and expiry are rejected, supported mobile boundaries are preserved and teardown is verified.

work_items.title: Repair renewable signed authority and entitlement continuity
work_items.done: Provider-issued renewal uses the supported renewable route and exact node/account scope, preserves existing customer/lifetime/developer rights and reports required consent precisely; no local self-issued lease, copied trust root or fabricated entitlement is permitted.

work_items.title: Resume authorized work automatically after compaction and restart
work_items.done: Actual native agent/SDK runs cross successive compactions, a process restart and model/session transition, automatically revalidate retained grants and perform the next eligible action without a new continue prompt; exact anchors, source turns, delivered context and execution effects are fenced and deduplicated.

work_items.title: Select effective tools and recover from genuine failures without false blockers
work_items.done: Current capabilities, permissions and consumer health drive point-of-need tool selection and typed bounded recovery; unavailable introspection is not stale-contract proof, read-only independent work continues, and optional reporting outages do not create repair circularity or bypass mandatory security/quality gates.

work_items.title: Align documentation, existing skills and Pi guidance with proven flow behavior
work_items.done: Existing owning guides/runbooks/skill mirrors and plugin guidance describe the same verified continuation, credential and recovery contract; generators/parity tests pass, native reload and actual agent consumption are proved, and periodic review uses the existing maintenance owner without new paid automation.

work_items.title: Prove sustained candidate flow and hostile-boundary failures end to end
work_items.done: Real admitted candidate harnesses execute the reference mission and fault matrix with a model, actual tools, protected broker use and consumer verification; zero avoidable re-prompts, unauthorized actions, leaked values, duplicated effects or false completion; unsupported environments are not claimed passed.

work_items.title: Audit complete issue acceptance, release evidence and repair-outage handling
work_items.done: Every selected issue criterion maps to passing evidence or remains explicitly open; no umbrella closure by subset proof; required benchmarks, security gates, exact-candidate CI, cross-version and release-matrix obligations are complete; outage behavior is tested and never fabricates success.

work_items.title: Publish and deploy the complete signed stable Flow State candidate
scope: canonical full-release controller and published assets
work_items.done: Canonical version selection, strict preflight, exact-source CI, immutable tag, every required signed platform asset, public Latest, trust verification and approved installer/rollout complete without bypasses; earlier releases, customer data and rights remain intact.

work_items.title: Verify installed autonomous flow and close only fully accepted issues
scope: approved installed runtime and fresh native Pi/claimed harnesses
canonical issue acceptance and evidence owners
work_items.done: Installed reference mission and negative matrix pass after native reload, including real post-compaction next action, retained authority, broker injection, tool recovery and visible truthful pauses; only issues whose entire done-condition is proven close, with linked receipts and measured outcomes.

work_items.title: Settle the admitted workset and preserve continuous documentation upkeep
scope: existing Spec138 learning and release journal
work_items.done: Canonical runtime admission/bindings and evidence are reconciled without retroactive authority; all required dispositions are met before settlement; actual outcomes/benchmark lessons and a resumable exact next step are retained; remaining program work stays open and no new scheduler/store is introduced.

work_items.title: Route every session to goal-directed project or ad hoc work
work_items.done: The actual session/admission owner explicitly uses an existing valid or fully bootstrapped project trajectory, or a labelled ad hoc route with a retained inferred working objective. Offer useful goal choices for consequential ambiguity without blocking obvious bounded approved work. Preserve mode/goals/choices and exact grants across compaction, corrections and explicit project promotion; no goal-less or authority-bypass route is allowed.
